_caveat: Counts are submission/record counts from field or free-text matches, NOT deduplicated curated variant-condition assignments. Disease-name [dis] field for 'Laing distal myopathy' and 'distal myopathy' returned 0 (controlled-vocabulary mapping artifact); free-text [All Fields] counts are shown and are the interpretable numbers. Use as landscape context only.
_interpretation: The MYH7 variant knowledge base in ClinVar is overwhelmingly cardiomyopathy-oriented (~5070 cardiomyopathy records vs ~400-700 skeletal-myopathy records; ~84% vs ~8-12%). The SRX-energetics evidence and myosin-modulator pharmacology are likewise cardiac-derived. This documents a data-representation imbalance: skeletal rod-myopathy (Laing/myosin storage) is comparatively under-represented, a curation-relevant gap for evaluating the hypothesis in its target disease.
